security-properties.description: Tamper-evident audit trail of operations on this interface, recorded by the privileged side. Caller identity (pid/tid, uid/gid, container or cgroup, binary path or hash) is taken from the kernel's view of the client, never from the request payload; each record also carries what was submitted and what it touched (context/channel id, request digest, handles and address ranges, completion status) and a monotonic, boot-qualified timestamp. Records are append-only and hash-chained, with checkpoint signatures over the chain head using a key held in a TEE/HSM, and the client has no write or unlink permission on the log. Log pressure has an explicit fail-safe policy (deny the operation or record a gap marker) so flooding the logger cannot silently erase accountability.
